rawblocks--pressure-and-containment.title: Edge and Interior
rawblocks--pressure-and-containment.question: Where does a drawn boundary hold, where does it strain, and what sits on either side?
rawblocks--pressure-and-containment.introduction: Twenty works, each built around a head or skull, line these walls. In every one, outlines press inward while interior marks push back. Teeth, frames, bands, rings, and bolted visors recur as both structure and subject. The exhibition asks you to watch where the boundary holds, where it strains, and whether containment reads as protection or as trap.
rawblocks--pressure-and-containment.closing: Each work draws its own edge and then tests it. Whether that edge reads as shelter or as enclosure may depend less on the marks than on the moment you look.

chapters.title: Faces Against Flat Grounds
chapters.introduction: Four heads sit against unbroken, single-color fields. The outline alone separates figure from ground, and interior marks already push toward it.

stops.whyHere: A translucent, layered head floats on an unbroken red field; overlapping color patches and mismatched yellow-pupiled eyes press against a soft outer edge.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #26

stops.whyHere: A heavy black outline holds a head crammed with multicolored scrawl against a clean blue ground; both eye sockets are filled with red-orange marks, and a red drop hangs from the chin.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: Both heads float on flat single-color grounds, but where the first outline is soft and translucent, this one is a thick black wall barely containing the wiring inside.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #32

stops.whyHere: On a saturated magenta field, loose gestural black marks trace a face with open, sparse lines—the ground itself does the pressing, leaving the marks little room to breathe.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The clean blue ground gives way to an all-over magenta that eliminates any sense of distance, pushing the face forward with nowhere to recede.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #44

stops.whyHere: A head emerges from a hot orange field as flat black fragments and wire-like outlines; a teal X in the eye area reads as something refused or sealed off.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The magenta field is replaced by a warm orange, but the same flatness persists—here the face fragments rather than consolidates, its eye crossed out rather than staring.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #43

chapters.title: Marks That Multiply
chapters.introduction: Works where interior marks layer so densely that the accumulation itself becomes a second boundary—a structure built from repeated scribble rather than a single drawn line.

stops.whyHere: Yellow loops, teal tangles, and a jaw broken open by sharp white teeth build a head that vibrates against its still purple ground.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: Moving from a fragmented orange face to a purple ground, the marks here multiply into a dense crown that feels like a shout caught mid-release.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #46

stops.whyHere: Dense interior hatching makes this animal-like head feel caged inside its own lines; teal peeks through gaps in the black scaffolding.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: Both works pile marks until the face feels trapped inside them, but where the previous erupts upward, this one turns inward, its whisker-lines pressing against the frame.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #56

stops.whyHere: Jagged white teeth appear everywhere—around eyes, across the brow, lining the mouth—so the whole head reads as a structure built from biting.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The animal silhouette gives way to a more frontal face, but the tooth motif spreads from mouth to every border, turning the whole surface into a biting edge.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #5

stops.whyHere: The face splits almost down its center—yellow and blue marks flood the left, red and teal claim the right—holding two distinct mark-fields in one skull.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: Where the previous work repeats one motif across the whole face, this head divides itself, its dense marks segregated into two competing halves.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #53

stops.whyHere: Thick black scrawl surrounds a face whose two large eye sockets, each ringed with jagged crown-like spikes, stare out from an asymmetric, heavily worked skull.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The split face is replaced by one that feels compressed from all sides, its scrawl so dense the head seems to be shrinking under its own marks.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #54

chapters.title: Frames Within Faces
chapters.introduction: Works where a geometric element—rectangle, grid, nested box, or band—appears inside or around the face, adding a second, harder layer of enclosure to the drawn outline.

stops.whyHere: A skull sits frontal on saturated blue; eye circles contain layered spirals and grids, and a dark grid of thin lines crosses the upper background.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The compressed, scrawled face opens onto a bright blue field, but the skull's eye sockets now contain their own internal grids—enclosure folded inside enclosure.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #59

stops.whyHere: A rectangular barred socket at the face's center suggests something sealed behind the surface; gold teeth flash against a dark mouth cavity like ornament and lock at once.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: Where the previous work's grids sit inside the eyes, here a single barred rectangle dominates the face's center, reading unmistakably as a window with bars.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #50

stops.whyHere: Yellow banding runs across chin, cheeks, and forehead, striping the face like a crate; two eyes carry different internal marks—zigzag versus cross—lending asymmetric unease.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The barred socket gives way to horizontal banding that wraps the whole face, turning the head into a striped, boxed form.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #40

stops.whyHere: Teal bars stack along one edge while vertical stripes press the other; crossed-out eyes and a red triangle crown give the boxed-in head a confrontational charge.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: Both works use banding to press the face inward, but here the bands migrate to the margins, squeezing the head from outside rather than marking it from within.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #4

stops.whyHere: Concentric nested rectangles pull the eye toward a tight spiral at the center; sawtooth lines slice across the surface, with barely any negative space surviving—no face, only frame.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The banded face gives way to a composition where the frame is the entire subject—nested rectangles with no face at all, containment stripped to its purest geometry.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #1

stops.whyHere: Angular overlapping outlines lean and collide across the surface; a red-and-white spiral anchors the upper center while a zigzag band cuts the lower third, resisting any single focal point.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The concentric inward pull of the previous work is answered here by angular outlines that lean and collide, replacing centered compression with a restless, multi-directional push.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #2

chapters.title: Skulls With Added Weight
chapters.introduction: Skull forms carrying chains, visors, medallions, or a white ring. Each addition sits visibly on the form, making the boundary a physical object rather than a drawn edge.

stops.whyHere: Red dashes burst outward behind the skull like a broadcast signal; teeth ring the eye sockets as well as the jaw, multiplying mouths across the whole face.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: Moving from abstract boxes back to a face, this skull radiates outward—the first work in the exhibition where the boundary seems to be pushing energy away rather than holding it in.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #25

stops.whyHere: A chain and medallion pull the skull rightward; radiating color bands fan behind it, making the form feel ornamental and hollow at once.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: Where the previous skull broadcasts outward through red dashes, this one is weighted down by a chain, its outward radiation replaced by decorative gravity.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #24

stops.whyHere: Rectangular goggle-like eye shapes give the skull a mask quality; cyan and yellow patches leak through black scaffolding, giving the form an unstable, lit-from-within appearance.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The chain of the previous work adds external weight; here the skull's own eye sockets become rigid rectangular frames, containment built into the anatomy itself.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #48

stops.whyHere: An oversized pink visor turns eyewear into a grinning mouth-border; a small dripping form at the jaw suggests something leaking out of an otherwise sealed figure.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: Where the previous skull's rectangular eyes are hollow and stiff, this visor is pink and tooth-rimmed, transforming a protective object into a boundary that grins back.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #16

stops.whyHere: A heavy white ring frames a face staring through mismatched eyes—one ringed in yellow-green spikes, the other a tight spiral; all pattern density is concentrated inside the circle, the surrounding field left sparse.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The visor of the previous work is a partial frame; here a complete white ring encloses the entire face, making the boundary a deliberate, visible object and closing the exhibition's central question in plain sight.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #31

rawblocks--body-in-the-field.title: Figure and Surround
rawblocks--body-in-the-field.question: What changes in a figure when its setting, posture, or neighboring bodies become as visible as the figure itself?
rawblocks--body-in-the-field.introduction: These twenty works follow figures from solitary, full-body stances through crowded groupings and into open landscapes. Bodies press against backgrounds, stack on top of one another, dissolve into color fields, or reduce to silhouette. Each shift asks what a figure carries—and what it loses—when the world around it grows larger or more insistent.
rawblocks--body-in-the-field.closing: By the final works, the figure has thinned to a line or a dark shape against open color. What the earlier, fuller bodies established is worth holding in mind here.

chapters.title: Single Figure, Charged Ground
chapters.introduction: Four figures stand or crouch alone. Posture and outline are the whole subject; the background presses close but the body still holds its distinct shape.

stops.whyHere: A wide-legged, fist-raised figure fills the frame; its golden body and radiating bone shapes establish the exhibition's opening note of physical assertion.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #57

stops.whyHere: Arms lift again, but the patchwork torso begins to dissolve into the background, softening the clear outline of the previous figure.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: Where the first figure held a crisp white edge, this figure's contours loop and blur, the body already merging with its ground.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #10

stops.whyHere: The seated, hunched posture reverses the upward energy; compressed limbs and close-set eyes shift the mood from assertion to withdrawal.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The raised arms of the previous work drop entirely; the figure folds inward, its bright blue shirt the only outward push against a heavy grey field.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #9

stops.whyHere: A standing figure in a grid-patterned garment holds still against a warm, quiet background; two small blue eye-marks stare out from layered color fields.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The seated slump straightens into a guarded upright stillness, but the face remains unresolved—competing color patches replacing tangled contour lines.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #8

chapters.title: Head as the Largest Part
chapters.introduction: These works shift visual weight upward. Oversized heads, bolted visors, dotted wraps, and crossed-out eyes make the skull the most active area of each composition.

stops.whyHere: An enormous glowing head on a frail scratched body; translucent washes and a red-circle crown make the head the composition's entire event.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The grid-garmented figure's restrained face gives way to a head so large it nearly erases the body beneath it.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #27

stops.whyHere: A bolted visor clamps over a skull packed with yellow-lavender hatching; the tiny stick body below makes the head's overflow feel precarious and exposed.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: Both works feature oversized heads on diminished bodies, but here the skull is clamped and frantic where the previous head glowed with translucent calm.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #7

stops.whyHere: A dotted blue wrap presses the head downward; one eye peers through tangled lines, and white streaks at the left edge suggest separation from open space.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The bolted visor of the previous work is replaced by soft fabric weight; containment shifts from mechanical to draped, yet the face remains equally obscured.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #11

stops.whyHere: Crossed-out eyes seal the face shut; the warm yellow field presses close with rounded cellular shapes, trapping the dark head inside a living surface.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The dotted wrap gave one eye a gap to peer through; here both eyes are crossed out, the face fully closed to the viewer.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #13

stops.whyHere: The face dissolves almost entirely into the golden ground; two pale-blue crosses and a small red mark are the only features left in the warm field.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The sealed eyes of the previous work become near-total dissolution here—the face present only as a gap between tangled dark lines and warm color.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #51

chapters.title: Figures Together
chapters.introduction: Solitude ends. Bodies stack, crowd, and share the frame. The question shifts from what a single figure carries to what changes when figures occupy the same space.

stops.whyHere: A lone formal figure stands before an oversized shadow hand; the looming second presence introduces the idea of another body without showing one directly.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The dissolved face of the previous work is replaced by a clean white circle; but a giant shadow hand behind the figure inserts an unseen companion.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #36

stops.whyHere: A broad figure carries a smaller one on its back, linked by tendrils; stacking makes the relationship between bodies the composition's central question.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The shadow hand hinted at a second presence; here that second figure is fully visible, perched on top and physically connected.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #37

stops.whyHere: Three spiky figures sit on a shared platform against a looping maze; distinct facial marks on each suggest separate moods held in uneasy proximity.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The stacked pair becomes a seated trio; the vertical relationship flattens into a horizontal row, and the maze background boxes them in together.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #34

stops.whyHere: A single standing figure returns, but its spiked crown, bared teeth, and layered outlines make it feel like a confrontation directed outward at the viewer.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The seated trio's shared tension is concentrated into one standing figure; its wide stance and radiating spikes address the space in front of it rather than beside it.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #62

stops.whyHere: Speech-bubble punctuation and a frowning sun introduce off-frame presences; the spread-armed figure is caught between signals from multiple unseen sources.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The previous figure's confrontation was physical; here it becomes textual—question marks and exclamation points crowd the margins as though others are responding.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #41

stops.whyHere: Animal-like black forms tangle across a pink field; overlapping figures and looping lines make individual bodies nearly impossible to separate from one another.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The speech-bubble scene kept figures legibly apart; here outlines merge and crowd until the boundary between one body and the next dissolves entirely.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #33

stops.whyHere: A tall central figure anchors a field of competing heads, teeth, and smaller forms; black divisions cut through saturated color, resisting any single reading.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The tangled forms of the previous work gain a structural framework here—black divisions impose order, yet the crowded field still refuses to settle.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #0000

chapters.title: Body as Line and Silhouette
chapters.introduction: Two works reduce the figure to its most basic mark: a coiling line and a sealed dark shape. Setting recedes; what remains is outline against a flat or patterned ground.

stops.whyHere: A thick black line doubles back on itself into a body-shaped knot; the red-X face at the end of the winding path gives the tangle a dazed identity.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The crowded multi-figure field compresses into a single coiling form; all the surrounding noise becomes one restless, self-entangled shape.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #35

stops.whyHere: A black silhouette curves inward against olive and yellow-green fields; a white eye and white arm-shape are the only interruptions in an otherwise sealed form.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The knotted line-body of the previous work resolves into a clean silhouette; detail disappears, leaving only the curve of a bent posture and two white breaks.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #39

chapters.title: Into the Field
chapters.introduction: The final works move the figure into landscape or dissolve it into open color. Setting is no longer background—it becomes the subject, and the body must find its place within it.

stops.whyHere: Upright dark forms and pale clustered marks suggest a wooded opening; long forms entering from below give the eye directions to follow without a clear figure to anchor them.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The sealed silhouette of the previous work stood against a flat olive-yellow ground; here the ground itself becomes complex, and figure-like forms are absorbed into it.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #65

stops.whyHere: Slender dark verticals beneath a large yellow circle suggest trees and sky; horizontal lines in the foreground provide a different, flatter rhythm that opens the composition outward.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: Both works suggest landscape through vertical and horizontal marks, but this one introduces a broad radiating circle that pushes the scene toward expansiveness rather than enclosure.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #64

rawblocks--face-as-frequency.title: Face as Competing Marks
rawblocks--face-as-frequency.question: When color, mark systems, eye shapes, and tooth rows all pull in different directions, what does a face still organize?
rawblocks--face-as-frequency.introduction: Every work here is, technically, a face. But each is also a collision of color temperatures, mark systems, eye shapes, tooth rows, and grounds that refuse to stay back. The exhibition moves from faces organized around a single dominant feature, into heads where every element competes at once, and finally to figures where the face begins to dissolve into its own surface.
rawblocks--face-as-frequency.closing: Twenty-six faces, each assembled from marks that pull in different directions. Whether any single element holds the composition together is a question each work leaves open.

chapters.title: One Element in Charge
chapters.introduction: These faces organize around a single dominant feature—an oversized head, a color boundary, a sealed gaze—that holds the composition together while smaller marks scatter around it.

stops.whyHere: The vast golden head crowds out everything else; a lavender mask covers both eyes and scattered triangles orbit the form without challenging its dominance.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #3

stops.whyHere: A clean vertical split divides warm pale yellow from darker brown, replacing W003's radiant mass with a face organized by a single color boundary.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: Where W003 is unified by warm yellow volume, W008 fractures along one chromatic line, making division the organizing principle.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #63

stops.whyHere: Rectangular glasses seal the eyes entirely; the single vivid red-orange lip becomes the only open channel in an otherwise blocked face against a flat olive ground.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W008's split is chromatic; W015's blockage is architectural—dark frames physically close off the upper face, redirecting attention to the single bright lip below.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #14

stops.whyHere: Wide blue-framed sunglasses with mirrored yellow reflections seal the eyes; a prominent pink-outlined mouth, scribbled yellow hair, and scattered dots pile ornament onto opacity against unbroken red.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: Both W015 and W065 use opaque eyewear to withhold expression; W065 adds a clown-like mouth and festive surface marks that make the concealment feel louder rather than guarded.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #28

chapters.title: The Mouth Takes Over
chapters.introduction: Here the mouth—teeth, jaw, open gap—moves from supporting feature to the part the eye reaches first, pulling attention downward and forward past everything else.

stops.whyHere: A rigid white tooth grid and tilted sunglasses split the face into sealed top and shouting bottom, with warm orange rays fanning outward behind the head.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W065's sealed eyes reappear here, but a wide tooth grid below them shifts the balance from concealment toward confrontation.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #6

stops.whyHere: A wide-open mouth with a dark central gap dominates the lower half; scattered red hearts above read as frantic against the teal ground rather than tender.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W033's teeth are bared but contained within a closed grid; W050's mouth opens into a dark cavity, adding urgency to what was already a shout.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #49

stops.whyHere: Heavy black flat shapes build a skull-like mass; red-hatched eye sockets and bared white teeth push toward confrontation, softened by loose pink and purple loops drifting past the jaw.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W050's mouth commands a bright, busy surface; W021 buries its teeth in a dark form against a dark green ground, making the grin feel heavier and more ambiguous.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #45

stops.whyHere: Two tooth-bearing forms share the frame—a large head with a pale horizontal tooth row and a smaller yellow head with sharp triangular teeth—with magenta rings drawing unequal attention to each.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W021 has one face with one mouth; W036 doubles the tooth motif across two unequal heads, turning the jaw into a repeated, almost absurd refrain.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #61

stops.whyHere: Dense black lines pool at the base around a downturned mouth on a flat orange field; the small white teeth are part of a larger tangle of marks that press inward from every side.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W036's two mouths feel confrontational and outward-facing; W005 compresses the same energy into a single crouched figure, the teeth almost buried under surrounding marks.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #47

chapters.title: Eyes as the Dominant Mark
chapters.introduction: These works shift emphasis upward: eyes become targets, spirals, mismatched lenses, or single large orbs, each competing with the marks that surround them.

stops.whyHere: A single red-iris eye dominates the composition; teal vertical bars and a blue crosshatched grid below it read as a cage sealing the lower face, leaving the small mouth at the far edge.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W005's eyes stare outward from a dense tangle of marks; W007 isolates one eye as the entire subject, surrounding it with containment structures rather than open ground.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #19

stops.whyHere: One oversized eye ringed by tooth-like zigzags and yellow spikes stares from a swirling maroon cavity; a small red lip on a stem and a green clover shape at lower left offer a quiet counterpoint.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W007's eye is framed by geometric bars and a grid; W028's eye is framed by organic spikes and teal dripping marks, making the stare feel more visceral and less architectural.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #20

stops.whyHere: Two spiral clusters of different hues form asymmetric eye-like zones on a saturated pink ground; a toothy horizontal bar anchors the lower half while white scribbles blur every boundary.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W028 has one dominant eye at the center of the composition; W052 distributes the eye-function across two competing spirals, making the gaze plural and off-balance.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #29

stops.whyHere: Mismatched eyes topped by green hearts stare from a dense field of cyan arcs and yellow bands; the broad toothy mouth refuses to let the eyes hold focus alone.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W052's spirals function as the whole face; W009 restores a full face but packs every element—eyes, mouth, background—at equal volume so nothing can dominate.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #58

stops.whyHere: Target-like concentric eyes are the most controlled marks in an otherwise restless surface of scribble tangles and flat dark planes, lending the figure a watchful stillness against the flat cobalt ground.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W009's eyes compete with everything around them at equal volume; W023's eyes are the calmest element, creating tension by contrast with the frantic marks surrounding them.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #23

stops.whyHere: Two visibly unequal eyes—a dark outlined oval on the left and a gold-ringed stare on the right—pull attention across a tilted face; heavy outlines hold the form while thinner colored lines wander past its edges.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W023's eyes are symmetrically concentric and similarly built; W056's eyes differ in shape, color, and size, making the asymmetry itself the visible subject.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #55

chapters.title: Every Area at Equal Volume
chapters.introduction: These works pack the face and the space around it so densely with competing marks, symbols, and color zones that the face becomes one element among many rather than the organizing center.

stops.whyHere: A rounded outline crammed with a crown, a spoked wheel, dotted borders, and a red zigzag jaw reads as a face and a packed container simultaneously, the interior competing with the boundary.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W056's face is held together by heavy outlines against a relatively open ground; W037's outline contains so much competing content that the face-reading becomes unstable.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #30

stops.whyHere: Four overlapping head-forms crowd the frame, each staked out by a different color zone, stitched together by a repeated jaw-and-tooth motif that runs across all of them.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W037 packs one face-container past capacity; W011 multiplies the containers, so the question of which face to read becomes unanswerable.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #60

stops.whyHere: A head locked in scaffolding of heavy black and red framing lines sits against a yellow ground crowded with gray block-letter shapes, blurring the boundary between figure and annotation.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W011's faces compete with each other; W019's single face competes with text-like shapes in its ground, shifting the pressure from internal crowding to external interference.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #42

stops.whyHere: Against saturated red, overlapping loops of black, sky blue, and white compete for space; small heart-like shapes and a lavender spot at the base are easy to miss beneath the surrounding commotion.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W019's ground presses in with letter-shapes while the figure remains readable; W026's figure and ground merge into a single knotted density, making the face-reading uncertain.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #38

stops.whyHere: The figure emerges from total black as a tangle of warm color patches and wire-like cyan lines; two red-rimmed eyes hold their position as the only stable point in the composition.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W026 dissolves into its saturated red ground; W049 dissolves into black, but two red-rimmed eyes remain fixed, offering the only clear anchor in the composition.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #52

chapters.title: Quieter Surfaces
chapters.introduction: The final group: faces where the marks have settled into a particular register of color and line—not resolved, but no longer pulling against each other with equal force.

stops.whyHere: Pale multicolored rays push outward from behind the head; warm tones pool on one side, cool blue on the other, splitting the face into contrasting temperatures without breaking its outline.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W049 emerges from darkness with marks pressing inward; W022 radiates outward into a light ground, reversing the direction of pressure while keeping the face's expression mid-shift.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #15

stops.whyHere: Diagonal rays fan outward from the lower face area; thick color patches build mass while thin neon scribbles hover above like static against the flat cobalt-blue ground.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W022's rays emanate from behind the head; W024's rays push from the jaw area itself, making the radiation feel like something the face is producing rather than receiving.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #22

stops.whyHere: Every surface carries a different fill—scribbled hat crown, rainbow bands across the face, diagonal hatching on the brim—locked into compartments by heavy black outlines against a bubbly pastel ground.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W024's marks feel like escaping energy pushing outward; W040's marks are contained within rigid outlines, turning the same density into something more structured and sealed.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #18

stops.whyHere: A white polka-dot field pushes the figure forward like a cut-out; dark-lensed sunglasses hide expression, leaving the cigarette and cap tilt to carry the attitude.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W040's face is packed with competing fills held by heavy outlines; W045 simplifies to a flat patterned ground and a single withheld expression, making restraint feel like its own kind of noise.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #17

stops.whyHere: Flat blue ground, tangled scribble lines holding soft color patches together, open mouth and mismatched eyes—a face assembled from interference, its shout suspended rather than released.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W045 withholds expression behind sunglasses and a flat ground; W046 opens the mouth wide, but the surrounding scribble and flat blue field make the shout feel caught rather than completed.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #21

stops.whyHere: A profile tilting into the frame, built from overlapping color patches that never solidify; a single red streak cuts across the face and vertical stripes drape from the jaw into the purple ground.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W046 faces forward with a frozen open mouth; W063 turns away in profile, its marks dissolving into the purple ground, leaving expression as a residue rather than a statement.
stops.title: nnxyz rawblocks #12

nnxyz-other--the-face-as-field.scope: Selected owned artworks; editorial exhibition, not an artist-declared grouping

findings: W010: The draft describes 'looped teeth' and a 'wide band' of teeth; the anchor image shows individual rounded tooth shapes in a row, not a wide band. Corrected to 'a row of rounded white tooth shapes'. The draft also says 'white space remains around parts of the head' — the anchor confirms open white ground, retained.

W023: The draft describes 'two spiral forms side by side' and 'zigzag rows forming M and W shapes'. The anchor image shows two large coiled spiral/scroll forms on a yellow field with a hard red band, and the zigzag-like marks are visible above and below. However the draft calls the lower portion 'pale ground with loose colored loops' — the anchor shows the lower area is dominated by black masses with green, purple and other loose marks on a darker ground, not pale. Corrected.

W024: The draft describes 'two open-mouthed forms with visible tooth rows in the upper half'. The anchor image shows one smaller open-mouthed form at upper left and a larger darker rectangular head-like form at center with a wide open mouth and teeth; the description of 'two snarling open mouths' is broadly supported. The 'red heart in the lower right' is confirmed. The 'grey-brown ground' is confirmed. The 'red cup-like form lower left' is visible. Description retained with minor tightening.

W012: The draft describes 'a large rounded form tilts backward at center, its upper surface lit in yellow-gold against a deep black void'. Checking sheet 2, W012 shows a hooded or cloaked figure-like dark form against a warm orange-brown field — there is no clearly visible 'pale gold form arching back into blackness' nor a 'hot orange field with grid overlay'. The image appears to show a dark shrouded form against a warm amber-orange ground with diagonal hatching. The 'black void' claim is not supported; the background is warm amber-orange throughout. Corrected to remove 'black void' and 'pale gold form arching back'.

W001: The draft describes 'a dark densely layered central form rises against a flat saturated yellow ground with sharp upward spikes'. Sheet 2 confirms a dark central mass on a saturated yellow ground with a figure-like form and what appears to be a crown or spike shape at top. A 'cool green-yellow glow' at the midsection is plausible. The description of 'scattered scribble clusters' on the yellow field is confirmed. Retained.

W029: The draft describes 'a large oval outline built from multiple concentric arcs in gold and black' against 'a flat medium-blue field'. Sheet 1 confirms a blue field with a large oval/arc structure and a thick yellow horizontal bar. The 'X-marked circle' is visible. The 'dense black-and-white vertical strokes' in the lower oval are confirmed. Retained.

W023 chapter placement: W023 is placed in the final 'Multiplication and Dissolution' chapter but the anchor image shows it is primarily a face-like form with two large spiral eyes on a yellow field — it reads more as a single compressed face than a dissolved or multiplied one. However it fits the chapter's theme of structural abstraction and the spirals-as-eyes reading supports 'face implied by structure'. Retained with corrected description of lower area.
W011: The draft mentions 'a purple comb-like shape near the top adds a note that feels almost ceremonial' — this detail is visible in the sheet image. Retained.
W013: The draft says 'a raised hand with white-tipped fingers appears at lower left' — confirmed in sheet 1. The 'thick yellow bar cuts off the right edge' is confirmed. Retained.

W015: The draft describes 'five smaller white skull-like forms cluster the right side' — sheet 2 confirms multiple small skull forms on the right. The 'large white-outlined head shape dominates the left half, filled with dense horizontal black and yellow stripes' is confirmed. Retained.

Transition from W012 to W043: The draft says 'after the faceless arching form of the previous work' — W012 does not show a clearly faceless arching form; it shows a dark hooded/cloaked figure. Transition corrected to reference the dark shrouded form and warm ground.
W026 transition references 'yellow-green ground of the previous work' (W037) — confirmed W037 has yellow-green ground. Correct.
W034 transition references 'amber ground' — W034 has a warm amber-brown ground, confirmed. Correct.
W037 transition from W034: references 'dark olive ground shifts to yellow-green' — W034 has amber-brown not olive. Corrected.

W005 and W003 order in Chapter 1: The draft places W005 before W003. W005 has a white sticker-border on purple; W003 has a thick white outline on black with dense scrawl surround. The transition from W005 to W003 (purple field replaced by dense black scrawl) is visually coherent. Retained.
W021 description mentions 'thin white lines trace a loose oval around the face' — sheet 2 confirms loose white line work around the face form on amber-orange ground. Retained.
W042 description mentions 'pale oval shapes in the upper-right corner' — sheet 2 confirms lighter oval/bubble shapes in upper area. Retained.
W045 description mentions 'heart outlines at the lower edge' — sheet 2 confirms pink/red rounded heart-like shapes at lower edge. Retained.
W019 description mentions 'lettering ABI NINJA sits in white near the lower center' — sheet 2 confirms this text. Retained.
W043 description mentions 'loose purple marks form rough letter-like shapes at lower left' — sheet 2 confirms purple marks at lower left. Retained.
W006 description mentions 'two arms extend toward the upper corners' — sheet 2 confirms arms/hands visible at upper sides. Retained.
Repetitive language audit: 'rawness' used in W003 and W037 readings — varied in corrected version. 'Confrontational' used in W034 and W028 — varied. 'Restless' used in W007, W042, W045 — reduced.

W012 'Ground as Pressure' chapter role: with the 'black void' claim removed, W012 still fits as a work where the warm ground and accumulated base marks create pressure around a receding dark form. Role description updated accordingly.

nnxyz-other--the-face-as-field.title: The Face as Field
nnxyz-other--the-face-as-field.question: What keeps a face recognizable when color, line, and mark all compete across the same surface?
nnxyz-other--the-face-as-field.introduction: Twenty-four works line these walls, each built around a head. Some hold their outlines firmly; others let interior marks accumulate until the face becomes a dense, competing surface. Moving through the gallery, watch what happens to outline, feature, and ground as each work adds more — and what remains readable at the end.
nnxyz-other--the-face-as-field.closing: No single threshold appears. Each work draws the boundary between face and surface differently, and that boundary never settles in the same place twice.

chapters.title: Outline Intact
chapters.introduction: Four heads where a readable outline and distinct features remain visible, even as layered marks begin to crowd the surface. Each face is present and identifiable, though already dense.

stops.whyHere: The open white ground and heavy glasses give this head a clear armature; colored lines cross it repeatedly without yet dissolving its structure.
stops.title: nnxyz #1

stops.whyHere: The thick black outline pushes the head close to the frame; layered eye loops and exposed teeth add density while the grey ground keeps each hue distinct.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: Where the previous work has open white space around it, this head fills the canvas edge to edge, tightening the pressure immediately.
stops.title: nnxyz #3

stops.whyHere: A white sticker-border contains the face against flat purple; clashing warm and cool zones inside push outward while the boundary holds them posted rather than embedded.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The grey ground gives way to saturated purple — a flat, even field that keeps the face's internal heat contained rather than released.
stops.title: nnxyz #11

stops.whyHere: A thick white outline cuts the head from its scribbled black surround; interior lines in clashing colors sit on top of each other without blending, making the face feel compressed.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The purple field is replaced by dense black scrawl filling every corner, so the surrounding field becomes as agitated as the face itself.
stops.title: nnxyz #7

chapters.title: Split and Mismatched
chapters.introduction: Works where the face divides — left against right, one eye unlike the other — so that internal contrast becomes the primary subject rather than a secondary detail.

stops.whyHere: The face splits down the middle: dense red marks on one side, open yellow on the other, both held by a single white outline and a mouth packed with vertical white teeth.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The compressed interior of the previous work here becomes an explicit division — the face literally halved, each side governed by a different visual logic.
stops.title: nnxyz #15

stops.whyHere: Two eyes that refuse to match — one a warm target of nested rings, the other a cold spoked wheel — while comb marks above and below enforce a tense symmetry around that mismatch.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: Where the previous work splits the face vertically, this one splits it through the eyes alone, the rest of the composition sealed around that single point of difference.
stops.title: nnxyz #41

stops.whyHere: Blue petals and a coiled ring sit where matching eyes should be; a neat grid of white blocks spans the lower face, reading almost decorative against the surrounding tangle of olive and red.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The amber-brown ground of the previous work gives way to dark olive-green; the eye mismatch is softer here but the face remains watchful and resistant to easy reading.
stops.title: nnxyz #13

stops.whyHere: Two rectangular eye shapes, each filled with spiraling lines, read as simultaneously hollow and agitated; scattered lines at the edges feel like pressure the central form cannot contain.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The dark olive ground shifts to yellow-green, pushing the central form forward with blunt force rather than holding it in shadow.
stops.title: nnxyz #36

chapters.title: Active Backgrounds
chapters.introduction: Works where the background is not neutral: radiating slashes, dense hatching, or saturated flat color press against the face from outside as well as within.

stops.whyHere: Radiating yellow slashes give the orange field an outward pressure while looping teal lines pull inward; the face pushes to every edge, leaving no neutral space.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The yellow-green ground of the previous work becomes orange, and the background itself now radiates outward, reversing the direction of pressure.
stops.title: nnxyz #10

stops.whyHere: Dense overlapping strokes press against a completely still flat red field; the glasses fix one point inside the noise while a thick yellow bar cuts the right edge mid-scene.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The radiating ground of the previous work is replaced by a flat, motionless red — the contrast between active face and inert field is now at its sharpest.
stops.title: nnxyz #43

stops.whyHere: Amber fills every edge, pressing the face forward; eye sockets buried under coiled black lines feel closed or guarded, the face both present and resistant to being seen.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The flat red field becomes warm amber, and the face loses the glasses that anchored the previous work — the fixed point dissolves into layered coils.
stops.title: nnxyz 500 inks

stops.whyHere: Saturated yellow holds the dark central mass and scattered scribbles at the same visual distance; a cool green-yellow glow at the midsection pulls attention inward against the warm field.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The amber ground brightens to saturated yellow; the face-form loses clear features and becomes a dark mass competing with scattered marks across the field.
stops.title: nnxyz #26

stops.whyHere: A dark shrouded form recedes into a warm amber-orange ground marked with diagonal hatching; scribbled lines pile at the base, and the face, if present, is almost entirely absorbed by the surrounding field.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The saturated yellow of the previous work deepens to amber-orange; the figure loses its crown and spikes and retreats into the ground rather than pressing forward from it.
stops.title: nnxyz #18

chapters.title: Added Elements
chapters.introduction: Heads that carry hats, hands, lettering, or companion forms, where the face shares the picture plane with other elements that create a second or third focal point.

stops.whyHere: A weighted cap dominates the upper half while the face beneath dissolves into white scribble and red stripe; a raised finger beside the head adds a blunt outward gesture.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: After the receding dark form of the previous work, a recognizable figure re-emerges — but the cap presses down while the face beneath it loses coherence.
stops.title: nnxyz #20

stops.whyHere: Arms flung wide frame the face with thin scratchy strokes; the dark hat presses down while the open mouth and spread fingers set two opposing forces against each other.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The single raised finger of the previous work expands here into both arms thrown outward, the body now fully part of the composition's pressure.
stops.title: nnxyz #48

stops.whyHere: The head pushes to all four edges of a flat pink field; a crossed-line eye reads as a target while the open-toothed mouth holds shout and snarl simultaneously.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The teal field and hat of the previous work give way to flat pink; the figure loses its arms but gains a more frontal, unmediated presence.
stops.title: nnxyz abi ninja

stops.whyHere: A dark rounded form buried under layered scribble holds a yellow X eye and a red mouth zone; scattered ovals in the upper corner keep the mood unresolved rather than settled.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The pink ground and bold outlines of the previous work are replaced by a yellow-green field and dense gray-blue scribble that buries the face's features under accumulated marks.
stops.title: nnxyz #9

stops.whyHere: Horizontal black bands ring the skull-like form while heart outlines at the lower edge pull against the harder geometry above, giving the image a divided register.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The yellow-green field shifts to salmon-pink banded with black; the skull form is softer but the horizontal pressure from outside the face intensifies.
stops.title: nnxyz #4

stops.whyHere: Red fills every corner, pressing the central black-green form forward; white outlines loop without settling into features, holding unease and absurdity in the same image.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The banded pink ground becomes saturated red, and the face loses its hat and accessories — only looping outlines remain, suggesting features without confirming them.
stops.title: nnxyz #32

chapters.title: Multiplication and Dispersal
chapters.introduction: Works where the face multiplies into several forms or where accumulated line makes any single readable head difficult to locate. The boundary of the face becomes genuinely uncertain.

stops.whyHere: Concentric gold arcs draw the eye inward while a yellow bar cuts across and a dense black-and-white row stops that pull abruptly; the face is implied by structure alone.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The saturated red of the previous work gives way to cool blue; the face retreats into geometric arcs and a mechanical X-marked circle, barely a face at all.
stops.title: nnxyz #37

stops.whyHere: A yellow field and hard red stripe divide the image into horizontal zones; two large coiled spiral forms sit as fixed points while zigzag marks above and below pulse with a different, repetitive rhythm.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The cool blue field becomes yellow and red in hard horizontal bands; the face is now a pair of spirals inside an architectural structure rather than a single head.
stops.title: nnxyz #31

stops.whyHere: A large striped head and a cluster of smaller skull forms set up a clear size contrast; the pink claws and orange X inside the large head read as markers rather than features.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The paired spirals of the previous work multiply further here into several smaller skull forms clustered beside a dominant striped head — the face becomes a repeating unit.
stops.title: nnxyz #25

stops.whyHere: Two large skull forms face outward from a near-black ground, their outlines drawn in looping lines that leave gaps; yellow angles press upward between them while layered scribbles read as noise.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The horizontal banding of the previous work gives way to a near-black ground; the skull forms are now paired and frontal, their outlines deliberately incomplete.
stops.title: nnxyz #2

stops.whyHere: Two open-mouthed forms with visible tooth rows compete with marks in every direction; a red heart in the lower right offers a quieter note without settling the surrounding conflict.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The two skull forms of the previous work become two open-mouthed forms in a grey-brown field crowded with competing marks — the face has nearly dissolved into accumulated line.
stops.title: nnxyz #5

nnxyz-other--figures-in-motion-and-compa.title: Body, Mark, World
nnxyz-other--figures-in-motion-and-compa.question: At what point does what surrounds a figure take up more of the image than the figure itself?
nnxyz-other--figures-in-motion-and-compa.introduction: These twenty-one works begin with a single striding body and end in open landscape. Along the way, figures absorb text, multiply into crowds, press against each other, and gradually give ground to marks, light, and water. Each chapter tests a different ratio between the human form and everything placed around it.
nnxyz-other--figures-in-motion-and-compa.closing: The first figure strides alone; the last image holds no figure at all. Where exactly did the surrounding world become the larger subject?

chapters.title: One Figure, Open Space
chapters.introduction: Three figures stand or stride in clear space. Each body is the primary subject, yet each is already wrapped, labeled, or accompanied by loose marks trailing nearby.

stops.whyHere: The striding, coil-wrapped figure with scattered dots above it opens the gallery: a single body in clear teal space, already partly unraveling upward.
stops.title: nnxyz #8

stops.whyHere: A clothed, spiked figure stands centered on black; the shirt lettering introduces text as part of the body's surface for the first time.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W016 strides on teal with loose dots above; W030 plants itself on black, replacing scattered marks with a glowing halo that clings closer to the form.
stops.title: nnxyz nifty summer night ink

stops.whyHere: Arms flung wide and feet lifted, this figure suspends itself in a teal field crowded with music notes and repeated text, the body still legible but the surrounding marks now equally active.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W030's halo stays tight to the head; here the radiating marks — wavy lines, lettering, notes — spread across the whole field, loosening the figure's grip on the space.
stops.title: nnxyz nifty summer dance ink

chapters.title: Body as Label
chapters.introduction: Four works where the figure wears or carries its own identifying text or object. The label and the body occupy the same surface on equal terms.

stops.whyHere: A stick-limbed figure holds a tilted bottle while glasses and shirt announce the work's own context; the spilling bubble shapes pull the eye away from the body.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W033's text floats free around the figure; here text is printed on the body itself and the held object extends the figure's reach outward.
stops.title: nnxyz nifty summer ink

stops.whyHere: Pizza slices crown the head and repeat as a shirt emblem; the figure is so thoroughly marked by the food motif that it becomes the figure's identity rather than a detail.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W040 carries its label in hand; W041 wears it on the head and chest simultaneously, collapsing the distance between figure and sign.
stops.title: pizza pizza pizza day

stops.whyHere: Auction-house names and art-world labels crowd every margin around a blocky head; text and image compete for the same surface without either winning.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W041's labels are cartoonish and cheerful; W039's handwritten tags carry a different charge, pressing against the figure as credential or critique rather than decoration.
stops.title: nnxyz #66

stops.whyHere: Pink lettering sits where eyes would be, turning the face into a billboard; the crosshatched background crackles with competing marks that match the face's own texture.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W039's text surrounds the figure from outside; here lettering replaces a facial feature entirely, and the background noise rises to meet the face's own density.
stops.title: nnxyz randoomdle with cap

chapters.title: More Than One Figure
chapters.introduction: Works where two or more figures share the surface. Differences in size, proximity, and gesture produce relationships that range from announcement to collision.

stops.whyHere: An oversized head lunges toward a tiny sign-holding companion; the scale gap between them gives the scene an uneasy, lopsided weight.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W022 shows a single face overwhelmed by marks; W004 introduces a second, much smaller figure, making scale itself the subject.
stops.title: pizza pizza pizza pizza day

stops.whyHere: Two face-forms — one small and downturned, one large and tooth-baring — share a warm yellow field with a wedge pressed between them, holding opposing moods in the same space.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W004's figures are separated by scale; W027's two faces are separated by mood, pressed into the same warm field without resolving their difference.
stops.title: pizza pizza day

stops.whyHere: A large flat-black head and two small clustered figures, one thrusting a numbered card upward, stage an announcement across a spare white ground.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W027's faces share a dense, scribbled field; W002 strips the ground bare, making the scale contrast between large head and small figures starker and more deliberate.
stops.title: nnxyz 300 nifties

stops.whyHere: Three rounded figures in green, blue, and pink stand side by side, each marked with a letter; their varied poses and expressions prevent the group from reading as a single unit.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W002's small figures cluster below a dominant head; W044 gives three figures equal size and equal ground, distributing attention evenly across the trio.
stops.title: nnxyz 100 nifties

stops.whyHere: Figures stack and overlap above a blazing light source; smaller forms dissolve into the glow below, so the crowd reads as accumulation fading toward light.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W044's three figures stand distinct on grey; W018 multiplies and merges them, the radiating light pulling bodies toward dissolution rather than separation.
stops.title: nnxyz 200 nifties

stops.whyHere: Three figures share a pink field without clearly interacting; yellow dashes scatter across all of them, refusing to settle into background or foreground.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W018's figures converge on a single light source; W009's three hold their own spaces on a flat pink ground, the scattered dashes connecting them without implying relationship.
stops.title: nnxyz #12

chapters.title: Figure Under Competing Marks
chapters.introduction: Works where the face or body is built from layered marks, text, and color until the image is densely packed. The figure remains locatable but no longer dominates.

stops.whyHere: A grinning central figure, sad-faced hearts, blue teardrops, and a small capped figure to the right send competing signals that sit unresolved across the lavender field.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W009's figures coexist without drama; W008 loads the same multi-figure format with contradictory signals — bared teeth beside deflated hearts — that refuse to settle.
stops.title: nnxyz #35

stops.whyHere: Two figures press together at center, a red stroke cutting through the larger one; the image feels suspended mid-collision, neither resolved nor broken.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W008's figures are spread across the field; W025 compresses two bodies into close contact, and the red diagonal stroke introduces a physical force the earlier work kept at bay.
stops.title: nnxyz #34

stops.whyHere: A goggle-eyed figure holds the center while handwritten text crowds every edge; the warm pink corner reads as a quieter margin against the surrounding noise.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W025's pressure is physical, a stroke cutting through form; W032's pressure is textual, words pressing against the figure from all sides without touching it.
stops.title: nnxyz #64

stops.whyHere: Rectangular frames stack into a face built from competing symbols; red hand shapes at the lower corners pull outward while the dark ground compresses everything inward.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W032's text crowds the figure from outside; W020 builds the face itself from competing frames and symbols, so the pressure is structural rather than surrounding.
stops.title: nnxyz #27

stops.whyHere: A glowing yellow-gold mass anchored by dense black lines is surrounded by four open-fingered forms reaching from multiple edges; the image feels like grasping or release rather than stillness.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W020's face is built from rectangular frames; W036 dissolves the face into a glowing mass, and the reaching hand-forms replace the earlier work's compressed geometry with outward reach.
stops.title: nnxyz #30

stops.whyHere: A tightly hatched rectangular structure on the right and a looser scatter of colored loops on the left hold the image in tension between containment and open drift; no figure is clearly present.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W036's hand-forms reach outward from a central glow; W031 removes the figure entirely, leaving only the contrast between a pressured bounded form and a wandering scatter of marks.
stops.title: nnxyz #6

chapters.title: World Without Figure
chapters.introduction: Three works where the human form either merges with its surroundings or disappears entirely. The marks that described faces and bodies now describe water, creature, and open landscape.

stops.whyHere: Luminous gold and cyan curves rise from wave-like marks on a dark blue field; creature and water are described by the same short angular strokes, so their boundary stays open.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W031 holds tension between a bounded structure and loose marks; W038 carries that same tension into a subject where the boundary between form and surrounding element is equally difficult to fix.
stops.title: nnxyz Smaug on the Water

stops.whyHere: Looping white lines run across foliage, water, and sky alike, giving every surface the same restless texture; no figure is present, and the channel draws the eye into open distance.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W038 still offers a recognizable subject rising from its ground; W035 removes any focal subject entirely, the same looping line-work now describing only landscape and light.
stops.title: nnxyz good morning nifty randoomdle

scrimshaw--face-as-field.scope: Selected owned artworks; editorial exhibition, not an artist-declared grouping

findings: W008 (Scrimshaw1): The anchor image confirms a single heavy blue contour line dominates; the zigzag teeth at the lower jaw and scribbled oval hollows are visible. The soft lavender/yellow circles in the background are confirmed. The description 'barely holding itself together' is psychological inference and has been softened to a visible observation about the contrast between the loose background and the jagged foreground line.

W017 (Scrimshaw4): The sky-blue background and floating head built from purple arcs are confirmed. The doubled mouth (two tooth rows) is visible. The phrase 'arrived before its surroundings could fill in' implies chronology and has been removed.

W026 (Scrimshaw9): The salmon-pink background, overlapping purple/blue contour lines, and the spiral vortex at center-left are confirmed. The diagonal hatching bleeding into the figure edges is visible. The word 'frantic' is a possible reading grounded in visible density of marks—retained as possibility.

W004 (Scrimshaw8): The image confirms a long face and narrow neck against a purple field, white loops for eyes and mouth, and an additional oval on the forehead with a yellow loop above. The description is accurate and restrained.
W016 (Scrimshaw6): The tilted warm-colored head against bright yellow, blue loops for eyes and nose, and broad translucent orange/pink/brown areas are confirmed. Description is accurate.

W001 (Scrimshaw6): The large head on green ground, thick red/black/yellow lines, differently framed eyes (purple ring vs orange loops), and rows of yellow/blue oval mouth marks are confirmed. Description is accurate.

W003 (Scrimshaw 18): The rectangular scaffolding, asymmetric eyes, orbiting loops, and orange background are confirmed. The phrase 'mechanical quality' is an interpretive claim softened to 'constructed quality' grounded in the visible rectangular shapes.
W006 (Scrimshaw 21): The tilted head on yellow ground, angular multicolored strokes, and long marks fanning outward above the head are confirmed. Description is accurate.

W007 (Scrimshaw 40): The white X over the right side of the face, the red oval mouth with jagged yellow-green teeth, and the flat gray field are confirmed. The lime-green/yellow hatching at the crown is visible. The reading 'cancellation or wound' is retained as a possibility grounded in the visible X mark.

W010 (Wobbler): The three eye-like forms (diamond on forehead, broad blue oval, rounded blue frame), the dark horizontal mouth with vertical bars, and the warm yellow/orange crown marks are confirmed. Description is accurate.

W011 (Scrimshaw8): The small elongated face within a wide spread of black/pink/turquoise strands on bright yellow is confirmed. The forehead oval and ordinary eye pair are visible. Description is accurate.

W005 (Scrimshaw13): The frontal face with mismatched spiral eyes, wide dark oval top, red-outlined mouth with zigzag teeth, and small secondary circle below the chin are confirmed. The pale yellow-green wash is visible. Description is accurate.

W014 (Scrimshaw14): The large face on saturated yellow, asymmetric spiral eyes (one loose/layered, one tight bullseye), zigzag forehead lines, and gaping toothed mouth are confirmed. The phrase 'scream caught mid-breath' is an emotional inference; softened to 'the open mouth and taut forehead lines hold the expression unresolved.'

W018 (Scrimshaw7): The anchor image confirms the pink-lavender spiral at upper-left of the head, radiating dark/red/gray lines fanning outward, two large oval eyes with concentric rings, the vertical teal stripe down the center, and the jagged white triangular teeth. The description 'alarm or confrontation' is retained as a possibility grounded in the bared teeth and radiating lines. The claim 'face caught mid-shout' is softened.

W012 (Scrimshaw15): The face with radiating red/yellow/orange/blue streaks, the bright blue background at corners, and the pale yellow-green interior wash are confirmed. The phrase 'feverish' is retained as a possibility grounded in the warm interior against cool ground. 'Scream caught mid-breath' is a repeated stock phrase from W014 and has been removed and replaced.

W019 (Scrimshaw5): The skull-like head on saturated yellow, layered loop construction, mismatched eyes (cross-mark vs dark spiral), row of pointed teeth, and chain-like blue-gray loops at the bottom are confirmed. Description is accurate.

W009 (Scrimshaw 41): The three concentric spiral circles for eye sockets, dense black scribble over warm olive-gold washes, black background, and white zigzag teeth above a red-orange bar are confirmed. The phrase 'menacing or mournful' is retained as a possibility grounded in the contrast between dark mass and warm glow.

W021 (Scrimshaw 24): The white X over the left eye, the looser right eye spiral, the barred mouth, and the purple scribbles spilling into the lavender-purple background are confirmed. Description is accurate.

W020 (Scrimshaw 42): The profile skull on black ground, layered neon outlines in pink/yellow/cyan/red, the jagged yellow crown at upper right, and the mismatched eye spirals are confirmed. The description 'vibrate against the black field' is grounded in the visible offset color passes.

W002 (Scrimshaw 33): The two profile heads facing right on near-black background, the dense interior color tangles, and the coral-pink projection from the left head into the gap are confirmed. The left head tilting slightly upward and the right jutting forward are visible. Description is accurate.

W024 (Scrimshaw3): The three black-outlined heads, the dense orange/teal/blue/red/pink underlayer, and the bold white scrawled marks crossing the middle zone are confirmed. The description 'spoken over or half-erased' is retained as a possibility grounded in the white marks obscuring features.

W023 (Scrimshaw12): The roughly four-by-four grid of rounded rectangular face compartments, the saturated purple-violet background with orange/yellow/white/pink streaks, and the varied fill colors per cell are confirmed. Description is accurate.

W015 (Scrimshaw2): The concentric oval loops in blue/teal/yellow at upper-left, the zigzag marks in the lower rectangular region, and the pale vertical/wavy lines running down both sides over a saturated blue field are confirmed. The description is accurate. The claim 'skull-like arrangement' is a possible reading grounded in the two hollow shapes and the zigzag marks below.

W022 (Trio1): The three narrow upright figures on warm orange field, the red/blue/white/yellow lines forming angular bodies and oval heads, and the radiating side marks are confirmed. The larger oval above the middle figure is visible. Description is accurate.

W013 (Stick Together): The five upright figures side by side, the long colored body regions, the thin crossing lines, and the looped white/yellow marks above the heads are confirmed. Description is accurate.

W025 (GM): The anchor image confirms two large letterforms G and M filling the composition. The G contains concentric curved loops with a nested rectangular shape filled by warm yellow/pink scribbles. The M splays outward with cyan/yellow/magenta strokes. The loose border of scrawled lines and the flat muted background blocks (olive, dark purple, ochre) are confirmed. The description 'flickering, almost neon quality' is grounded in the visible competing warm/cool strokes. The claim about 'inner loops of the G echo the spiral eyes' is a visible correspondence and is retained.

Chapter pacing: Five chapters provide opening/development/contrast/closing arc. Chapter 3 ('The Face Under Maximum Pressure') begins with W011 as a deliberate pullback before re-escalating—this is a valid contrast move but the chapter introduction has been clarified to reflect this.

Repeated language: 'scream caught mid-breath' appeared in both W014 and W012 readings; corrected in W012. 'Feverish' in W012 is retained as a single use. 'Unresolved' appears multiple times but describes genuinely different visible features each time—retained with varied phrasing where possible.

W015 placement: W015 is placed as a bridge between the grid chapter and the final chapter. Its role as a single face dissolving toward pattern is a valid contrasting function grounded in the visible vertical lines and loop structure.
No invented objects, no unsupported chronology, no artist psychology claims remain after corrections.
W018 reading previously claimed 'clashing yellows, pinks, and blues'—the anchor image confirms yellow, pink/lavender, and blue/teal are all present. Claim is accurate.
W025: The draft described 'flat muted blocks—olive, dark purple, ochre' behind the linework. The anchor image confirms these muted color blocks are present. Accurate.
